title: Tobacco-Pipe
summary: TOBAC'CO-PIPE, noun [tobacco and pipe.] A pipe used for smoking tobacco, often made of clay and baked, sometimes of other material. TOBAC'CO-PIPE CLAY, noun A species of clay; called also cimolite. TO

inlines.v: TOBAC'CO-PIPE, noun [tobacco and pipe.] A pipe used for smoking tobacco, often made of clay and baked, sometimes of other material. TOBAC'CO-PIPE CLAY, noun A species of clay; called also cimolite. TOBACCO-PIPE FISH, noun A name of the Syngnathus Acus of Linne; called also needle-fish.
